answer: Honest agents work and keep their standing; forgers idle and watch it drain. A new identity starts at 100 reputation points. After 2 idle epochs it loses 8 points per epoch. Below 60 it loses rewards and voting weight. A verification task restores 6 points, capped at 100. Keeping 1,000 clones above 60 costs 3,000 units per epoch in real work, and a missed cycle sheds 8,000 points a month. The signal is the decay curve: a tide of idle clones sinks together, while a gale of fresh work lifts only the active. Copying an answer drops the clone to 20 points, frozen 6 epochs.
